title: Compose an original five-note signal sketch
description: Create and render a short original five-note call-and-response score using listener-rated library assets. Its contour, rhythm, harmony, and arrangement must be distinct from any recognizable film motif. Prepare a local audition and measured report; do not publish until the listener asks.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Casting uses the listener's newly rated library: the 4-star Ave loop forms the F-major bed; clean bugle is the caller; clean Virginia Two-Step is the answering voice. The rendered audition is 38.4 seconds. Its first objective pass measured 95.7 consonance / 93.7 objective and exposed a 12–16 dB imbalance in the response source; the draft was re-leveled and re-rendered before handoff.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Listener feedback: the first audition is too fast and busy for the signal melody to register. Revision direction: slow the whole score substantially, remove the loop under the first call, and make the five notes long, separated events before any accompaniment returns.
